observations.contract: Travel geometry raw admission before validating getter
observations.trace: TravelGeometryPoint has public i32 longitude_e7 and latitude_e7 fields and derived Deserialize, while longitude() and latitude() call checked WGS84 constructors followed by expect. A source-level point with longitude_e7=2000000000 and latitude_e7=510000000 has both values within i32 but longitude beyond the checked 1800000000 limit; its longitude getter reaches expect on None. The pinned Serde derive, serde_core and serde_json sources show the inspected normal numeric-map path accepts an i32-valued field without a point-specific constructor. CompiledWorld retains inferred-edge geometry; its selected CLI input path deserializes the artifact then calls validate_world, and an inferred edge with valid identity, existing endpoints and a 2..512 geometry list reaches validate_inferred_geometry, which calls the getters before it can return its out-of-playable-bounds error. TravelEdgeLoad deliberately omits offline geometry after validation.
observations.remaining: This is conditional source and pinned dependency reasoning only. No crafted artifact, deserialization, getter, panic, validator, CLI, database or test ran. Earlier world checks, feature resolution, actual source provenance, all consumers and native ingress remain open; do not attribute this offline geometry to database transport. Original Adler340 q133 already records the admission contract; this source-consumer trace is newly assessed.

observations.contract: ReligionHours direct gate and raw admission
observations.trace: ReligionHours public f32 fields and direct_mut admit a hypothetical roman_catholic=NaN with lutheran=1000. direct_fields_valid(5000) rejects it, while effective(RomanCatholic) tests NaN<=0 (false), normalizes the NaN contribution to0 and transfers about800 through the Lutheran correlation. Simulation profile validation checks the finite bounds, and selected book and curriculum paths use direct_mut/effective. add_direct also accepts any positive finite gain without an intrinsic total cap.
observations.remaining: No invalid state, operation, skill training, product or test ran. Real producer bounds, other decoder/native admissions, total policy and actual consumer reachability remain open. Original root Lens3 q3139 was an open admission question; the specific gate case is current reasoning and is related to, not automatically identical with, written and bestiary gates.

observations.contract: Route terrain local versus contextual admission
observations.trace: RouteTerrain Serde reconstructs bounded collections and calls validate, checking field bounds, ordering, grade signs, slope/aspect and class relationships. validate_context additionally checks nonzero length, elevation-derived ascent/descent and grades, relief, risks and encounter tags. For a hypothetical flat placeholder with ascent changed to the valid value1, local validate does not compare ascent to the elevation profile, whereas validate_context does. Selected offline world validation and native travel-edge import both invoke validate_context with route and length.
observations.remaining: No placeholder, decoder, validation function, edge or test ran. Other standalone consumers or upstream paths might use local-only validation; discover those before retaining a production inconsistency. Original root Lens3 q3140 remains an open connected admission question.

observations.trace: The seven OfficialReligion::religion_id strings match the separate build-time RELIGIONS list. The catalog validator checks authored religion requirements and training entries against that list; TrainingTarget::Religion retains String and apply_curriculum_training converts with from_id, silently skipping unknown text.
observations.remaining: No actual mismatch or observed skipped training is claimed. General character faith may include values outside the seven official training religions; do not flatten the broader faith policy into this closed enum. Existing q2493 and q2454 remain distinct, and aliases with the related bestiary selector question are open.

observations.contract: Tree profile bounds after sequence decoding
observations.trace: ModeledTreeSpeciesProfile and InferredTreeSpeciesProfile deserialize their Wire fields as Vec before calling constructors that reject more than12 or4 entries, respectively. Pinned serde_core Vec visitor repeatedly reads and pushes all successfully decoded elements before returning. A 13-element syntactically valid modeled sequence is therefore decoded into the temporary vector before the constructor rejects its length. TreeSpeciesId grammar validates shape but has no explicit length bound in the selected owner. A separate bounded visitor in this file limits route-profile sequences during decoding; it still deserializes an element before checking the final over-limit condition.
observations.remaining: No payload, allocation, parser, product, test or denial-of-service was run or measured. The selected CLI already reads an artifact into memory; actual artifact-size constraints, native decoding and desired identifier/sequence limits remain open. This is a bounded-input and resource-policy question, not evidence of a live incident.
